title: Stories that say what is built
why: All ten stories say Not started although they are built, and nothing built since October has a story, so Status shows the product as further from done than it is.

suggestions.title: Tick the ten stories against the code, and leave newer work without stories
suggestions.why: Quick, and Status is right about what the stories cover

suggestions.title: Tick them, and run /survey to write stories for comments, the relay and testing
suggestions.why: Status then covers the whole product, at the cost of a longer run
